## Gravity-work fixer (`gravity-work-fixer`) {#sec-ch06-fixer}

Local symbols: $\varpi_s$ is the weight of stage $s$'s increment in the step (code `cw`). Tracked in ISSUES.md.

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Measure each step's $E_{\mathrm{tot}}+\mathrm{PE}_d$ defect $\mathcal D$ [J] of the cell form and add $-\mathcal D$
back as heat, uniformly per unit mass, @eq-ch06-fixer-fix.
**Data.** Per block: the stage-weighted defect, the fluid mass (total density, solid cells left out), the mass
through the $x_1$ wall faces, the wall cells' mass and a redo flag, five float64 numbers; writes $E$ of every
fluid cell.
**Placement.** Defects collected in each stage of `HydroImpl::forward`; one reduction over blocks and ranks and
one deposit after the last stage of the step.
**Activation.** `forcing/const-gravity/gravity-work-fixer`, default true with `gravity-work: cell`, refused with a
face form; requires $g_2=g_3=0$, non-periodic $x_1$ and no mass through the $x_1$ walls.
**Guarantee / limits.** $E_{\mathrm{tot}}+\mathrm{PE}_d$ to round-off per step, explicit and implicit; a global correction that
leaves the local error of the cell form.
**Evidence.** `fixer_check.py` `[C1]`-`[C4]`; `test_gravity_work_fixer` at `TOL` $=10^{-12}$, read from the
source, not run here.
:::

The cell form (@sec-ch06-cell) leaves a defect of $E_{\mathrm{tot}}+\mathrm{PE}_d$ every stage, @eq-ch06-cell-defect. The fixer
adds the defects of the stages with the weights they carry in the step, sums the result over every block and
rank, and subtracts it from the total energy in proportion to each cell's mass. Momentum and mass are untouched,
so the correction is a heating or cooling of the whole domain, of size $\mathcal D/M$ per kilogram. The run then
conserves $E_{\mathrm{tot}}+\mathrm{PE}_d$ to round-off per step, explicit and implicit, while the local work stays that of the
cell form.

It runs only with `gravity-work: cell` and $g_1\neq0$. Its terms leave out the boundary fluxes, so it refuses any
step that moved more than a round-off amount of mass through an $x_1$ boundary face, and it refuses a periodic
$x_1$ (the potential $-g_1x_1$ jumps across the periodic face) and $g_2$ or $g_3\neq0$. The fix is logged per step
as `fixgrav=`.[^ch06-fixer-src]

[^ch06-fixer-src]: The fixer, its implicit part and its wall bound came in with chengcli/snapy#283, #284 and #285.

### Derivation

Per stage $s$ the defect is @eq-ch06-cell-defect plus, with an implicit scheme, the change of
$\sum_iV_i(E_i+\phi_i\rho_i)$ across the implicit solve. A stage's increment enters the step's update
$\mathbf U^{n}\to\mathbf U^{n+1}$ with the weight $\varpi_s = w_2^{(s)}\prod_{t>s}w_1^{(t)}$, because each later stage
multiplies the current state by its $w_1$. For any quantity linear in the state the step's change is
$\sum_s\varpi_s\,\mathcal D_s$ (`fixer_check.py` `[C2]`); for rk3 the weights are $1/6$, $1/6$, $2/3$ (`[C1]`). After the
last stage the fixer applies

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal D &= \sum_s\varpi_s\,\mathcal D_s ,\\
E_i &\leftarrow E_i - \mathcal D\,\frac{\rho_i}{\sum_jV_j\rho_j},
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch06-fixer-fix}

with $\rho_i$ the total density, dry plus species, and immersed-solid cells left out. @eq-ch06-fixer-fix is
applied in `apply_gravity_work_fixer` as `efix`
({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::apply_gravity_work_fixer >}}).
Multiplying by $V_i$ and summing gives exactly $-\mathcal D$ (`[C3]`, $3.8\times10^{-16}$ relative). The wall
faces are left out of $\mathcal D$; a step is refused when the mass through them exceeds
$10^3\epsilon_{\mathrm m}M_{\mathrm{wall}}$, $2.2\times10^{-13}M_{\mathrm{wall}}$ in float64 and
$1.2\times10^{-4}M_{\mathrm{wall}}$ in float32 (`[C4]`). The bound is a round-off allowance, not derived; the code
comment records that reviewed rest decks were first refused near acoustic Courant 2500 (CUDA) and 2750 (CPU), and
says those are not universal thresholds. Checks: `src/snapy_report/ch06/fixer_check.py`, output
`fixer_check.out` [sha: the code at the pin, ported line for line: the stage weight `cw` of `HydroImpl::forward`
and the fix and wall bound of `apply_gravity_work_fixer`, whose arithmetic is unchanged at the pin (only the way it
reads its five sums differs from the lines the port was written from), and the stage weights of
pyharp@4721715855e937c1e8b218e964c0655f46e56e29; deck: the check itself; run: `python3 fixer_check.py`, numpy, exact
fractions].

### Numerical method

@fig-ch06-fixer-flow shows one step. Each stage of `HydroImpl::forward` adds its weighted defect to a buffer and
the mass that crossed the $x_1$ wall faces to another. After the last stage the block sums its defect, its fluid
mass, the wall-face mass, the wall cells' mass and a redo flag into five numbers; a `Mesh` with several blocks
adds the blocks first, and one allreduce sums them over ranks. A step the redo check will discard (a limiter
repair, a NaN, a failed implicit solve) is left alone. Then every cell gets its share and the physical
ghosts are refilled. A `Mesh` adds its local blocks one after another in
`gravity_work_fixer_sums` ({{< code src/mesh/mesh.cpp MeshImpl::forward >}}) and one `allreduce` adds the ranks
({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::advance_local >}}), so the order of the floating-point additions follows
the decomposition and the sum can differ between decompositions at round-off. That difference has not been
measured.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch06-fixer-flow
#| fig-cap: "The gravity-work fixer through one step, read top to bottom: each stage's defect is weighted by its weight in the step, the sums are reduced over blocks and ranks once, a step that moved mass through an x1 wall is refused, and the remaining defect is removed uniformly per unit mass. Green outlines mark operations, black arrows the order."
#| fig-alt: "Five boxes in a column connected by arrows: stage defect, stage weight, one allreduce, wall-mass refusal, uniform energy fix."
#| echo: false
```

### Code

| what | code link | symbol | switch |

| stage defect, wall mass | {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}} | `gwfix_stage` | `gravity-work-fixer` |
| implicit part | {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}} | `epe` | `implicit-scheme` |

: Code map of the gravity-work fixer. {#tbl-ch06-fixer-code}

1. Per stage, form the defect of the cell work, the face work of $F-F^{\mathrm{ref}}$ and the potential-energy
   change of the moved mass as `gwfix_stage` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}).
2. Add the mass that crossed the wall faces to `_gwfix_wall` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}).
3. Add the implicit solve's change of $E_{\mathrm{tot}}+\mathrm{PE}_d$ with `epe` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}).
4. Weight the stage by `cw` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}).
5. After the last stage, sum and reduce once in `gravity_work_fixer_sums` ({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::advance_local >}}).
6. Refuse on the wall bound, else add `efix` per unit mass ({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::apply_gravity_work_fixer >}}).

Messages a user can hit: "const-gravity gravity-work-fixer needs grav2 = grav3 = 0", "... needs non-periodic x1
boundaries", and at run time "const-gravity gravity-work-fixer: ... kg crossed an x1 boundary face this step".

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_gravity_work_fixer_python` | $E_{\mathrm{tot}}+\mathrm{PE}_d$ kept, explicit and VIC | $10^{-12}$ rel. | `TOL` |
| `test_gravity_work_fixer_python` | fixer off drifts | $>10^{-10}$ | planted control |
| `test_gravity_work_fixer_python` | refusals: outflow, periodic, $g_2$ | message | refusal text |
| `test_implicit_gravity_tall_column_python` | `cell`+fixer rest column (the deck states `cell`; the default is `face`) | $10^{-7}$ m s$^{-1}$ | `W_TOL` |

: Tests of the gravity-work fixer; assertions read from the test sources at the pin, not run. {#tbl-ch06-fixer-tests}

`test_gravity_work_fixer` runs a moving isentropic column between reflecting walls for 200 rk3 steps and requires
$\lvert\Delta(E_{\mathrm{tot}}+\mathrm{PE}_d)\rvert/\lvert E_{\mathrm{tot}}+\mathrm{PE}_d\rvert\le$ `TOL` ({{< code tests/test_gravity_work_fixer.py TOL >}}).
It also checks the refusals in float64 and float32, a Python-installed wall and a NaN wall cell sent to the
redo check. It runs on CPU with `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT=0`. Measured values at the pin are **missing
evidence**.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The fixer refuses open and periodic $x_1$ boundaries and any step that moves mass through an $x_1$ wall face
beyond round-off; for open boundaries set `gravity-work-fixer: false`.
:::

- It corrects the integral, not the local $O(h^2)$ error of the cell work.
- The order of the sums over blocks and ranks follows the decomposition, so the defect can differ between
  decompositions at round-off; not measured.
- At very large implicit steps sealed-wall round-off can exceed the bound (refusals of rest decks near acoustic
  Courant 2500 on CUDA and 2750 on CPU[^ch06-fixer-285]); not universal.
- Combinations with the study switches: @sec-ch12-matrix.

[^ch06-fixer-285]: The refusal thresholds are those recorded in chengcli/snapy#285 and in the code comment of
    `apply_gravity_work_fixer`.
